summary: Iteration 3 — Full frontend regression on the public preview URL. All 15 new/replaced routes load without runtime errors and 0 console errors captured across all flows. Verified end-to-end: Student Directory (grid/table toggle, search, 4 filters, click-card → /students/profile/:id), Student Profile (5 tabs: overview/academic/fees/attendance/documents; profile-wa → wa.me/+919812345671 URL ✓; profile-edit in header ✓; profile-collect-fee revealed on tab-fees ✓), Admission Full 7-step wizard reachable via Next clicks; adm-photo, doc-birth/aadhar/tc/caste/passport/other all present at step Documents; adm-submit-btn persists and navigates to /students/directory, Student Removal (search-on-type → removal-pick-* → reason/date/tcIssued/tcNumber/confirm; confirm successfully marks student INACTIVE — verified via rejoin page picking the same student), Student Rejoin (rejoin-search reveals only INACTIVE students; rejoin-keepOldAdm + rejoin-confirm reactivates → student reappears in directory under status=Active), Certificates (9 type options ✓; editable cert-body; cert-generate downloaded Bonafide_Certificate_ADM20253142.pdf ✓ — jspdf+html2canvas lazy import works), Classes & Sections (cs-add-btn opens modal; cs-sections/teacher1/teacher2/save all functional; 6 cs-edit-* and 6 cs-del-* rendered), Timetable (Nursery/Primary/High profiles + timing-start/end/periods/periodMin/save inputs all wired; tt-class/section/save present; tt-Mon-0 grid cell accepts text input ✓), Fee Setup (fs-cat-name/type/amount/add-cat + 70 fs-amt-* per-class fields rendered), Fee Collection (deep-link /finance/collect/s1 works; Cheque mode reveals fee-cheque + fee-bank ✓; fee-collect persists a transaction → 'Test Fee' visible in history and fee-download-receipt button appears ✓), Employee Add (all 7 inputs present incl. photo file input + emp-submit), RFID Attendance (rfid-sample parses 5 rows; rfid-class/section filters; rfid-commit + rfid-bulk-wa enabled after data load; commit clicked successfully), Leave Management (leave-new modal opens; leave-employee/type/start/end/reason/submit all wired; leave-approve-* + leave-reject-* render for pending rows), ID Card Studio (mode-student/staff + layout-v/h + side-front/back + 4 presets Indigo/Emerald/Rose/Midnight + 4 color pickers headerBg/cardBg/text/accent + studio-logo upload + 6 studio-sel-* checkboxes; QR SVGs render correctly via qrcode.react; studio-pdf downloaded 'id-cards-student.pdf' ✓). 0 PAGEERRORs, 0 console errors throughout test run.

issues: cs-name is implemented as a <select> dropdown of predefined classes (Nursery/LKG/1st/2nd…) rather than a free-text <input>. The review spec listed it as a text input. If the intent is to allow arbitrary new class names (e.g. 'Pre-KG' or 'XII-Science'), switch to <input> or add 'Custom…' option. Currently fine if predefined master-data is desired.

After removal-confirm successfully marks the student INACTIVE, the page stays on /students/removal without a redirect or visible success state besides a toast. Consider auto-navigating to /students/directory?status=Inactive or resetting the form for the next removal.

Pick options are gated behind `q && ...` — i.e. results only appear AFTER the user starts typing. The empty state ('No student found') with no list can look like the page is broken on first load. Consider showing the first 5-8 candidates by default.

design_issues.screen: Admission Form Step 1 — Date of Birth (carried over from iter 2)
issues: Still uses native <input type='date'> instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere — inconsistent with design system, non-blocking.
Persists on every authenticated page (expected in demo). Verify production hides it when Firebase keys are present.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider changing cs-name from <select> to <input> (or add a 'Custom…' option) if arbitrary class names are required by the product spec.
OPTIONAL: After removal-confirm, navigate to /students/directory or clear the form for the next entry — currently the user is left on the same screen with the toast as the only feedback.
OPTIONAL: Pre-list 5-8 students/inactive-students/cert candidates before the user starts typing in removal-search / rejoin-search / cert-search so the empty state isn't misleading.
OPTIONAL (P3, from iter 2): Replace native date input on Admission Step 1 DOB with shadcn Calendar.
critical_code_review_comments: Excellent test-id discipline across all 15 new pages — every interactive control, every dropdown, every checkbox, every dynamic list item has a stable data-testid. Made automated coverage straightforward.

PDF generation pipeline (pdfUtils.js → lazy jspdf + html2canvas) works on both Certificates (Bonafide_Certificate_ADM20253142.pdf) and IDCardStudio (id-cards-student.pdf) — no flicker, no console errors on first lazy-load.

Conditional rendering pattern (e.g. fee-download-receipt only after collect; rfid-commit/rfid-bulk-wa only after sample parsed; profile-collect-fee only on tab-fees) is implemented cleanly. Tests must follow the same UX path.
demoStore persistence verified across page transitions: removal → rejoin → directory state-mutation chain reflected correctly without page refresh.
ClassesSections — both cs-name <select> and cs-teacher1/2 use a small fixed enum; if the school expects arbitrary master-data this will become a blocker, otherwise it's a defensible UX choice.
test_credentials: admin@demo.school / demo1234 (verified). staff@demo.school / demo1234 and parent@demo.school / demo1234 — Demo Mode DEMO_USERS only. No Firebase.
seed_data_creation: Created during testing in localStorage demoStore (will reset on cache clear): 1 admission ('Test Student' via AdmissionFormFull), 1 collected fee for s1 ('Test Fee' ₹1500 Cash), 1 RFID attendance commit, 1 leave request, 1 removal+rejoin cycle for Aarav Sharma s1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested at https://benita-erp-demo.preview.emergentagent.com (also matches frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). All iter-3 features WORKING. PDFs download successfully (jspdf+html2canvas dynamic import; allow up to 12s on first call). When testing Removal/Rejoin/Certificates pages — you MUST type something into the *-search input first, otherwise the *-pick-* buttons are not rendered (by design). cs-name in Classes modal is a <select>, not <input>. Conditional rendering: fee-download-receipt only after a successful fee-collect; rfid-commit/rfid-bulk-wa only after rfid-sample (or CSV upload) parses rows; profile-collect-fee only when tab-fees is active.
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced. The two ‘missing element’ false alarms in the first regression sweep were caused by conditional rendering: (a) profile-collect-fee is inside the Fees tab content and absent while tab-documents is active — confirmed by re-clicking tab-fees → button present; (b) removal/rejoin/cert pick buttons only render when the search input has a non-empty value (`q && matches.filter(...)`) — confirmed by typing 'aarav' → 1 pick rendered; (c) fee-download-receipt only renders after the first successful fee-collect — confirmed by collecting ₹1500 Test Fee → button appears + Test Fee visible in Fee History; (d) rfid-commit / rfid-bulk-wa only render after rows are parsed from CSV — confirmed by clicking rfid-sample → 5 rows + buttons appear. All are intentional UX patterns, not bugs.
